English: Wagon Circle
A rough circle of wagons for shelter and basic defense, forming the nucleus of a nomadic camp.
Hide Tent Cluster
Clusters of hide tents for the growing community, providing better shelter and organization.
Yurt Hamlet
A small hamlet of felt yurts, offering improved habitability and space for larger families.
Leather Pavilion Camp
A camp of large, durable leather pavilions suitable for leadership gatherings and communal decision-making.
Wooden Yurt Village
A village of wooden-framed yurts, providing significant expansion and better comfort for the nomad community.
Reinforced Tent Settlement
A fortified cluster of reinforced tents and stockpiled supplies, prepared to withstand raids and harsh seasons.
Timber-Framed Yurt Town
A sizable town of timber-framed yurts and communal halls, bustling with prosperous nomad life.
Palisaded Nomad Village
A village encircled by a timber palisade, offering strong protection for people, livestock, and supplies.
Defended Encampment
A highly organized encampment with watchtowers, sentry posts, and defensive ditches.
Fortified Caravanserai
A grand, fortified hub for trade and gathering, boasting robust defenses and abundant stores for the entire horde.
